about_the_game:
It's an Interactive Movie, a love story happened in modern times.

The word Interactive, defines its narrative approach and plot structure, setting it apart from traditional movies;

The word Movie, forms its production standard and aesthetic foundation.

"As cinema was invented, human life has been extended threefold."

Though VR still has lots of problems, and Brain-computer Interfaces still linger on the horizon...

With the rise of POV filming, all it takes is just a screen, a pair of headphones:

We can now immerse ourselves in extraordinary life experiences.

In the world of this story, you—the one sitting in front of PC—won't play a character created by a screenwriter.

You are just you.

No one, will address you by a name that isn't yours.

If you’re here just to watch pretty girls flirt with you... apologies, this isn’t for you.

Feel free to swipe over to TikTok—endless beauties to watch, zero cost. A flick of your finger shouts "Bring me next one!" with capitalist efficiency.

But if you’re a parched traveler, craving soul’s nectar;

If you yearn for exceptionally talented actors, to share authentic scenes together with you:

Among them...

—One is a born sprite. At the age of nineteen, she seems to have been acting for two decades ...No, she is not acting a character. She is the charcter—the most shining girl in school, who lives next door, now knocking on yours and smiling at you.

—One is the model of professionalism, showing what it means pouring all heart into work she loves. Even the most complicated lines, she nails them without any mistake. No matter how many times her partner messed up, her acting stays perfectly flawness, every single time.

—One climbed a mountain path twenty times, just for a split-second perfect gaze. What a serendipity: She is not very good at acting. She just has a character just like her character. Loveliness, goodness, kindness...She won't bother performing them—she has them. Strangers call her gentle; friends say she defines gentleness.

...

If you’re willing to lose yourself in this narrative maze;

If you have hours to spare for a wonderful story that repays your time...

You won't hear any tedious narration, or read a long article describing characters and background.

After all, no great film will snatch your popcorn, then force-feed you a wiki.

Just take her hand, and step into your life.

Welcome, my friend.

Dear protagonist, come quick.

The spotlight awaits.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains sensitive contents including partial nudity or sexual innuendo, as well as alcohol use, violence, bloodshed, depictions of suicide or homicide. It may not be suitable for all ages.
